text:
The deploy went out, but staging isn't healthy. Image `api:7f3c2e1` was built, pushed, and applied to `deployment/api` on staging. The healthcheck then timed out after 60s with `/healthz` still returning 503.

I haven't determined why. The rollout may still be in progress, with pods slow to become ready, or the new pods may be failing (crashlooping, a bad config, or a dependency the fix needs). I didn't check rollout status or pod logs, so I can't tell which. `kubectl rollout status deployment/api -n staging` and the logs of the new pods would tell. If the new pods are failing, `kubectl rollout undo deployment/api -n staging` restores the previous version. Staging may be serving errors until this is resolved.
